Audit View
A new report under Reports. It lists Orders, Invoices and Payments for a date range you pick.
Paid
A payment the bank has confirmed: sent online, or a cheque that has cleared.
Cheque Pending
A cheque payment at Reconciliation Pending: the cheque is issued but has not cleared yet.
Other Pending Payments
Every other payment still in progress: Requested, CEO Pending, Approved, Reconciliation Pending (online) or Rejected.
Reconciliation Pending
The money has left the bank and waits to be matched to the bank statement. A cheque payment lands here as soon as it is approved.
CEO Pending
Approved by the team and waiting for the CEO.
TDS
Tax deducted at source: tax held back from a vendor's payment. Here, Net Paid = Amount Paid + TDS.
UTR
The bank's reference number for an online transfer.
Project Expense
A cost on a project outside the PO and Work Order flow. The app labels it Misc Project Expense in places.
WO / SR
A Work Order. Older screens called it a Service Request (SR).
PMO
The project management office role. With this PR it may view a vendor's cheques but not change them.
Before / After
Before is the code the PR starts from (develop at 42313959a). After is the PR's own code.
Role check
A test that one role sees, or does not see, what the PR says it should.
Must / Should / Nit / Note
How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
